name: iced-rs
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：iced-rs。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Iced 0.14 GUI framework expert — custom widgets via iced::advanced, overlays, Canvas, Shader, pane_grid, theming, subscriptions, Elm architecture. Load whenever building, modifying, or debugging any Iced UI. Bundled reference library covers the full 0.14 API; bundled examples include all upstream iced examples plus the iced_wgpu renderer source.
